data.name: Baazi: Dungeon Solitaire Collection
data.detailed_description:
More than solitaire. Every move matters.

Baazi is a curated collection of patience and solitaire-style card games built for players who want something calmer, cleaner, and more rewarding than the usual click-through routine.

While each game uses the familiar foundation of a standard deck, they go far beyond traditional solitaire: every title is built around structure, spatial logic, risk management, and meaningful decisions instead of mindless repetition.

Every layout is more than a pile of cards to clear—it is an intricate puzzle to read, unravel, and solve. You study the board, calculate tempo, manage your health and resources, and plan your sequence several turns ahead. The result is familiar yet fresh: easy to learn, clean to look at, and quietly absorbing.

6 Unique Games Included at Launch

  • Scoundrel (Dungeon Crawl & Risk Management)
    Descend into a dark dungeon room by room. Face rooms of four cards consisting of deadly monsters, healing potions, and weapons. Choose which encounters to fight barehanded, which weapons to conserve, and when to flee.

  • Joker Jailbreak (Maths & Color-Balancing Logic)
    A prisoner trapped behind card walls. Calculate and balance red and black card totals to unlock outer gates and create an escape path for the Joker before the prison seals itself shut.

  • Club Fight (3×3 Tactical Grid Combat)
    Wield a four-card club hand to battle across a dynamic 3×3 matrix. Manage suit locks, counter enemy maneuvers, and navigate strict 13-turn limits in a tense spatial duel.

  • Card Capture (Solo Tactical Deckbuilder)
    Turn the enemy’s arsenal against them. Capture opposing combatants using matching-suit weapons and utility items, steadily drafting and upgrading your deck before you are overwhelmed.

  • Clear the Dungeon (Monster Slayer & Damage Sequencing)
    Face down twelve fearsome dungeon beasts. Combine your deck into precise three-card attack sequences to fell high-health monsters before their counter-attacks deal fatal damage.

  • The Emissary (Solo Trick-Taking Diplomacy)
    A rare solo trick-taking experience. Travel across eight diverse kingdoms, balancing precise debate targets and bids to win diplomatic influence without overplaying your hand.

Features

  • 6 Handcrafted Games in One Package – Diverse mechanics ranging from dungeon crawling and grid combat to trick-taking and deck manipulation.

  • Logic-Driven Card Play – Low-luck, high-agency design where thoughtful planning beats mindless clicking.

  • Clean, Focused Aesthetic – Built with a minimalist, distraction-free presentation: beautiful bespoke typography, subtle color accents, and crisp card art.

  • Daily Runs & Replayability – Test your skill with fixed seeds, daily decks, and multiple difficulty modes.

  • An Expanding Library – Designed as a long-term home for the finest solitaire innovations, with more carefully selected games arriving in future updates.

data.short_description: A growing collection of patience and solitaire games with clean design, satisfying flow, and no unnecessary clutter. Just timeless card play, thoughtful presentation, and more games added over time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-core processor (Intel Core i3 or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 support (Intel HD 4000 or newer)
  • Storage: 250 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 14.04 LTS
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any GPU with OpenGL 3.3 or Vulkan 1.0 support (Intel HD 4000 or newer)
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
